<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def summ(f):
    cage=hole=None; nblob=0; key=False; donuts=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c=='G':
            b=n['boundary']; cage=(min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
        elif c=='g' and n['pixels']==2: hole=(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
        elif c=='g' and n['pixels']==12:
            b=n['boundary']; donuts.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
        elif c=='N': nblob+=1
        elif c=='p': key=True
    return dict(cage=cage,hole=hole,nblob=nblob,key=key,donuts=sorted(donuts))
def done():
    return last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
print("start:", summ(current_frame))
# Test 1: consume {B} only
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':6}])  # key -> blobs
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':25}])  # cage B
print("cageB:", summ(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':13}])  # hole (1,0)
print("T1 donuts:", summ(current_frame), "DONE?" , done())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def summ(f):
    cage=hole=None; nblob=0; key=False; donuts=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c=='G':
            b=n['boundary']; cage=(min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
        elif c=='g' and n['pixels']==2: hole=(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
        elif c=='g' and n['pixels']==12:
            b=n['boundary']; donuts.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
        elif c=='N': nblob+=1
        elif c=='p': key=True
    return dict(cage=cage,hole=hole,nblob=nblob,key=key,donuts=sorted(donuts))
def done():
    return last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
print("start:", summ(current_frame))
# Test 1: consume {B} only
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':6}])  # key -> blobs
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':25}])  # cage B
print("cageB:", summ(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':13}])  # hole (1,0)
print("T1 donuts:", summ(current_frame), "DONE?" , done())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
